verdict.rationale: A cloud sandbox platform could plausibly offer event-driven triggers, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents user-defined rules that fire actions on events. The readiness Probe (waiting for a TCP port) is an adjacent control, and the community GitHub Actions runner is a user-built workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
